advices.diagnosis: The class is a pure data holder with five trivial accessor methods, all touching distinct private attributes. This results in a very high LCOM4 (4) indicating low cohesion, while DCC is 0 and DAM is 1.0. The metrics confirm the data_class smell: many getters, no behavior, and all attributes are private.

suggestions.title: Add an aggregate method to connect accessors

advices.risk_notes: Adding the method increases WMC slightly and introduces a new public API that callers may need to adapt to. If the class is used extensively as a simple data holder, the new method may be unnecessary and could be omitted. The change does not affect DCC or DAM.
